chains.trait: Pinprick eyes and minimised central nervous system
links: Constant darkness and high acoustic impedance nullify vision/hearing
Nervous tissue atrophy conserves energy for chemolithotrophic digestion

skill.effect: The creature navigates through thick soil by sensing safe tunneling routes and actively steers clear of dangerous nanite zones nearby.

chains.weakness: Disoriented by sudden bright light or sharp high-frequency vibrations.
observe: Glass plains and dead cities overhead

journal.en: They traded sight and sound for survival. In the dark, a nervous system is a luxury they couldn't afford.

plausibility.summary: Prefer chemosensory/mechanosensory tunneling over ‘avoiding nanite hotspots’ unless F12 is explicitly toxic to them; rename hotspot avoidance to instinctive aversion to engineered interface residues.
fixes: Prefer chemosensory/mechanosensory tunneling over ‘avoiding nanite hotspots’ unless F12 is explicitly toxic to them; rename hotspot avoidance to instinctive aversion to engineered interface residues.

analogues.organism: Cavefish Astyanax mexicanus eye and brain regression; olm Proteus anguinus reduced vision and sensory economy in perpetual darkness (Culver cave adaptation)
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

skill.effect: It listens to vibrations in the ground to locate hidden burrows and muffles the sounds of nearby targets for a short while.

chains.weakness: Blind to surface light, panics when exposed to direct stellar radiation.

journal.en: They dig because the sky burns. Their nerves retreated inward, long before the sun cooled.
